Enrich the species table with class/order/family from the taxonomy cache

Source: R/ingest.R
enrich_taxonomy.Rd

Maintainer-side helper. Merges the offline GBIF backbone resolution cached in the private ingestion tree into the compilation species table, populating the class, order, family and is_vertebrate columns. The cache is regenerated by a maintainer script that calls the GBIF backbone API; the cached TSV is never user-facing.

Usage

enrich_taxonomy(spp, data_raw = NULL)

Arguments

spp

data.table of species with at least a species_id column.

data_raw

Path to a maintainer-side ingestion tree. Absent in the installed package; the function aborts when the directory does not exist.

Value

The species table augmented with backbone columns. Species absent from the cache are left with NA in those fields.

Details

If the taxonomy cache is missing inside an otherwise-valid ingestion tree, the function is a no-op and returns the input unchanged. The resolution is offline and uses a TSV the maintainer regenerates after compilation changes; the regeneration script lives in the private ingestion tree and is not shipped.

References

Chamberlain, S., et al. (2024). rgbif: Interface to the Global Biodiversity Information Facility API. R package version 3.8. https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rgbif.

See also

vt_ingest_all(), vt_ingest_dataset(), vt_compilation()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
co <- vt_ingest_all(data_raw = "<path-to-ingestion-tree>")
table(co$species$class, useNA = "ifany")
} # }
